denominator.en: One geometry · scripted tools · no learned VLA
denominator.zh: 一个几何 · 手写工具 · 无学习型 VLA

detail.en: 45 saved episodes in one seen geometry: 40 scripted Track C references and 5 faults. Narrow-window signed median error +0.333336 s fails the 0.1 s requirement.
detail.zh: 一个已见几何中保存 45 回合：40 个手写 Track C reference、5 个故障回合。窄窗 signed median error 为 +0.333336 s，未达 0.1 s 要求。

denominator.en: 4 cases · 1 seed / geometry · no population admission
denominator.zh: 4 案例 · 1 seed / geometry · 非群体准入

detail.en: Four fixed seen cases meet the per-case 0.1 s timing bound; maximum absolute error 0.016668233 s. Different banks prevent a matched performance-improvement claim.
detail.zh: 四个固定已见案例逐例满足 0.1 s 计时界限；最大绝对误差 0.016668233 s。与旧实验 bank 不同，不作匹配性能提升推断。

denominator.zh: 240 帧 · 2 预览 · 0 策略训练

detail.en: Two seen previews, 120 frames each. A has RGBD, proprioception and language; B adds only a timestamp. Static depth arrays do not establish dynamic depth freshness or the information gate.
detail.zh: 两个已见预览，每个 120 帧。A 为 RGBD、本体状态和语言，B 仅增加时间戳。静态 depth 数组不能证明动态深度新鲜度或信息门通过。

denominator.en: 20 captures · diagnostic markers excluded from benchmark
denominator.zh: 20 张捕获 · 诊断 marker 不进入 benchmark

detail.en: 20 development captures. Diagnostic marker counts are 3 / 5 / 5 across lens settings; maximum projection disagreement 0.889 px. Saved row motion is not calibrated volume or verified particle identity.
detail.zh: 20 张开发捕获。不同 lens 设置下诊断 marker 数为 3 / 5 / 5，最大投影偏差 0.889 px。保存行的移动不是标定体积或已验证粒子身份。

detail.en: 360 physics states and 60 nine-dimensional drive targets. Joint 1 moves 0.079997 rad and the fingers about 0.005 m. This is a limited actuator diagnostic, not a grasp or pouring evaluation.
detail.zh: 360 个物理状态、60 次九维驱动 target。joint 1 移动 0.079997 rad、finger 约 0.005 m。这是限定执行器诊断，不是抓取或倒液评测。

title.zh: 实际 Franka 驱动轨迹

denominator.zh: 1 次固定已见诊断 · 工程 FAIL

detail.en: 420 states, 70 captures and 71 target calls. The capacity error is cleared; maximum actual cup tilt is 89.627012° (<90°). Workspace containment also fails.
detail.zh: 420 状态、70 张捕获、71 次 target calls。容量错误已消除；实际最大杯倾角 89.627012°（小于 90°）。工作区留存同样失败。

denominator.zh: 5 条 CPU 轨迹 · 0 实际 Pour 事件

detail.en: Five planned target trajectories pass independent CPU kinematics and limit checks, with an identical start/end home. No native run, actual home tracking, collision clearance or three-second liquid cue is established.
detail.zh: 五条规划目标轨迹通过独立 CPU 运动学与限位检查，起止为同一 home。尚无 native 运行、实际 home 跟踪、碰撞净空或三秒液体 cue 证明。

title.zh: 共同 home 轨迹可行性

detail.en: R4 saves 420 states / 420 dynamics records / 70 captures. Native exits 0; the original audit exits 1 on the SDK float-rate type. R5 CPU reanalysis preserves all 11 gates: 9 pass, tilt reaches 89.612389° (<90°), and workspace containment fails. Receivers move; velocity-frame calibration and the earlier camera failure remain open. One exploratory GPU0 run, no scientific admission.
detail.zh: R4 完整保存420状态 / 420动力学 / 70帧，Native exit0；原审计因SDK浮点频率类型约束 exit1。R5 CPU重审保留全部11物理门：9项通过，倾角89.612389°（<90°）和工作区约束仍失败。接收杯实测移动，速度坐标标定与旧相机失败原因仍开放。仅一次探索性GPU0运行，未构成科学准入。

title.en: Complete dynamics capture / physical gates fail
title.zh: 完整动力学采集 / 物理门仍失败

denominator.zh: 已见开发证据 · 0 科学样本

detail.en: 420 states, 70 captures and 71 target calls. All eleven original gates were evaluated: 5 pass, 6 fail. 857 callback entries are recorded with no drops. Full acquisition does not establish fluid containment, a successful Pour or a qualified expert. Scene and instrumentation differ from V40; these rows are not a matched causal comparison.
detail.zh: 420 状态、70 次捕获、71 次 target calls；原十一项物理门中 5 项通过、6 项失败。完整记录 857 次回调且无丢弃。完整采集不等于液体保留、成功倒液或合格专家。场景和观测配置与 V40 不同，这些记录不是匹配因果对照。

title.zh: 完整回调观测 / 物理验收失败

denominator.zh: 已见开发证据 · 0 科学样本

detail.en: 90 states and 14 captures; the unchanged freshness guard rejects tick 90. All eleven physical gates remain NOT_RUN. Before control, warmup receiver-region retention is 56.5–59.6%. Region counts are not calibrated volume; changing the donor pose changes the containment predicate. Contact causality remains open.
detail.zh: 90 状态、14 次捕获；原新鲜度门在 tick90 拒绝采集，十一项物理门均未运行。开始控制前，预热后的接收杯区域保留率已为 56.5–59.6%。区域计数不是标定体积，供液杯位姿变化会改变包含判据；接触原因仍未确定。

title.zh: 初始化边界 / 采集未完成

denominator.zh: 已见开发证据 · 0 科学样本

detail.en: 420 states, 70 captures and 71 target calls. All eleven original physical gates were evaluated: 6/11 pass. The protocol allows at most three public rendering calls per stale boundary. This run made zero public rendering calls, so the recovery branch and conservation of recorded clock, joint state and hand pose under rendering remain NOT_TESTED. Particle/internal-solver conservation and atomic snapshots are not established. Complete acquisition does not demonstrate a rendering repair or population effect.
detail.zh: 420 状态、70 次捕获、71 次 target calls。原十一项物理门实际评估，6/11 通过。协议允许每个停滞边界最多三次公开渲染调用。本次实际公开渲染调用为零，因此恢复分支及渲染下所记录时钟、关节状态、手部位姿的守恒均未测试（NOT_TESTED）。粒子、内部求解器守恒与原子快照尚未证明；完整采集不证明渲染修复或群体效应。

title.zh: 有界渲染 / 实际结果

denominator.zh: 已见开发证据 · 0 科学样本

detail.en: 420 states, 70 captures and 71 target calls; original physical gates: 6/11 pass, 5 fail. After-reset arm home error is 0.087 rad and hand home position error is 9.76 mm, compared descriptively with 2.706 rad and 740.29 mm in the separate V50 trace. Receiver fluid loss before control and failed tilt/retention/workspace/floor gates remain unresolved. Zero public render calls: recovery and live clock/joint/hand conservation remain NOT_TESTED. These sequential single seen traces are not matched causal replicates and add zero qualified experts.
detail.zh: 420 状态、70 次捕获、71 次 target calls；原物理门 6/11 通过、5 项失败。reset 后关节 home 误差为 0.087 rad、手部位置误差为 9.76 mm；作为描述性对照，独立 V50 记录对应为 2.706 rad 和 740.29 mm。控制前接收杯液体损失及倾角、供液杯保留、接收杯保留、工作区、地板门失败仍未解决。实际公开渲染调用为零，恢复分支和现场时钟、关节、手部守恒仍未测试（NOT_TESTED）。连续的单次已见记录不是匹配因果复现，新增合格专家为零。

title.en: Initial joint state / complete physical failure
title.zh: 初始关节状态 / 完整物理验收失败

denominator.en: 1 attempted dry A · 0 control states · 7 NOT_RUN gates
denominator.zh: 1 次干态 A 启动 · 0 控制状态 · 7 项门 NOT_RUN

detail.en: USD load identity passed; four initialization boundaries and 17 camera callbacks were recorded. Vulkan reported driver 570.124.06 and Warp reported Driver 12.8. Zero control states and control captures: loaded-library classification failed after warmup. All seven dry gates are NOT_RUN. The exact rejected library path is NOT_RECORDED; SDK auxiliary-prefix overlap is a static risk, not identification of the original offender. The closed failure archive is intact; no qualified experts or benchmark samples were added.
detail.zh: USD 加载身份检查通过，已记录四个初始化边界和 17 次相机回调。Vulkan 日志报告驱动 570.124.06，Warp 日志报告 Driver 12.8。预热后库分类检查失败，控制状态和控制捕获为零；七项干态门均 NOT_RUN。被拒绝库的精确路径为 NOT_RECORDED；SDK 辅助库前缀重叠是静态风险，不是原失败库的身份鉴定。原失败档案已完整闭合，新增合格专家和 benchmark 样本为零。

title.zh: SDK 初始化 / 控制前库分类失败

denominator.en: 3 single dry runs · 1,260 states · 210 captures · C fails90°
denominator.zh: 3 条单次干跑 · 1,260 状态 · 210 捕获 · C 未达 90°

detail.en: Three complete single dry trajectories: 420 states, 70 captures and 71 target calls each. A/B peak94.835852° and pass7/7 dry checks; C peak89.709966° fails the unchanged90° gate (6/7). A uses a virtual hand-implied axis without a donor. Eleven common SDK body mass/inertia/drive descriptors match; A/B state streams are byte-identical despite different RGB. Calibrated effort/contact and full velocity admission remain open. Wet D was not run. Zero qualified experts or learned-policy fits were added.
detail.zh: 三条完整的单次干跑各有 420 状态、70 捕获、71 次 target 调用。A/B 峰值 94.835852°，干跑检查 7/7；C 峰值 89.709966°，未通过保持不变的 90°门（6/7）。A 无供液杯，使用手部姿态推算的虚拟轴。11 个共有 SDK 刚体的质量、惯量和驱动描述相同；A/B 状态流逐字节相同，RGB 不同。力/接触标定和完整速度准入仍开放。未运行湿态 D；新增合格专家和学习策略训练为零。

title.en: Actual dry robot / tool / receiver comparison
title.zh: 机器人 / 工具 / 接收器实际干跑对比

denominator.en: 1 dry run · 420 saved states · initialization FAIL
denominator.zh: 1次干跑 · 420保存状态 · 初始化FAIL

detail.en: One complete dry clearance run: 420 states, 70 captures, all 175 receiver colliders. Posthoc cup tilt94.839846°, full saved speed/limit0.909099, and 2,646,000 authored-bound pairs without overlap. The original audit rejects initialization before its nine-gate endpoint: reset/setup home error0.087001rad and nonzero velocity. Shape-path mapping and effective receiver offsets remain unverified. No wet, expert, training, calibration or online-agent result is admitted.
detail.zh: 一次完整干态间隙运行：420状态、70捕获、全部175接收器碰撞体。后验杯倾角94.839846°，全程保存速度/限值0.909099；2,646,000对authored bounds没有重叠。原审计在九门端点之前拒绝初始化：reset/setup home偏差0.087001rad且速度非零。shape-path映射和接收器后端offset仍未验证。没有新增湿态、专家、训练、实测校准或在线agent结果。

title.zh: 实际间隙运行：初始化仍未通过

denominator.zh: 1次干态诊断 · 420状态 · 九项检查9/9

detail.en: A fresh single dry run passes all nine frozen checks: 420 states, 70 captures and all 175 receiver colliders. Declared setup uses one position and one velocity write before warmup, with zero state writes afterward. Cup tilt reaches 94.84° and maximum speed/limit is 0.9091. Complete effective offsets, liquid, expert data, model fits, real calibration and online LLM comparisons remain open.
detail.zh: 新的单次干态运行通过全部九项冻结检查：420个状态、70次捕获、175个接收器碰撞体。声明的初始化仅在预热前写一次位置和一次速度，此后没有状态写入。杯倾角94.84°，最大速度/限值0.9091。完整有效偏移、液体、专家数据、模型训练、真实标定和在线LLM对照仍未完成。

title.en: Declared setup: all nine dry checks pass
title.zh: 声明的初始化：九项干态检查全部通过
